faq.name: What CSS expertise do you offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: I specialize in advanced CSS techniques including CSS Grid, Flexbox, responsive design, CSS animations, SASS/SCSS, Tailwind CSS, and modern CSS methodologies. I'm a CSS Expert with 6+ years of experience creating responsive, cross-browser compatible designs.

faq.name: Do you work with international remote clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, I work with international remote clients across all timezones. I'm experienced in remote collaboration using modern tools and communication platforms to deliver high-quality front-end development services globally.

faq.name: What technologies do you specialize in?

acceptedAnswer.text: I specialize in CSS, responsive design, React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, Tailwind CSS, SASS, and modern front-end development technologies. I'm particularly expert in CSS and responsive design solutions.

faq.name: Are you available for freelance projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, I'm available for international freelance projects and remote collaboration. I work with clients globally and am flexible with different timezones to accommodate project requirements.
